text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through the Tokyo Daishoten, Wonder Acute 
believed she had shown hope to those 
striving for a comeback. However—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Goal unachieved. When asked for their 
thoughts, just running steadily was only 
enough to cheer them up a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To show them true hope, she must display a 
"brilliance" in the race that outshines 
even Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To achieve this, she must abandon caution 
and ignite an instant blaze of passion. 
Throwing her future to the wind, Wonder 
Acute embarks on a do-or-die regimen of 
intense training.
